WELCOME TO OUR FARM

A small Appalachian farm focused on animals, simple living, and sharing the farm experience with visitors.

Life on Smoky Mountain Acres

We are building a working family farm in the mountains of East Tennessee with a focus on traditional animals, pasture, and practical homesteading.

  • Home to Kune Kune pigs, katahdin sheep, chickens, and other farm animals.
  • Focused on pasture-based care, simple systems, and responsible animal husbandry.
  • Growing toward private farm tours and an Appalachian-inspired experience for families and visitors.

Smoky Mountain Acres is still growing. Our goal is to create a welcoming place where people can meet the animals, learn how a small farm works, and experience a quieter side of life in the Smoky Mountains.

OUR ANIMALS

Meet a few of the animals that make Smoky Mountain Acres feel like home.

Kune Kune Pigs

Friendly, compact, and full of personality, our Kune Kune pigs are a favorite around the farm and are well suited to pasture-based living.

katahdin Sheep

Our katahdin sheep bring a hardy, traditional presence to the farm and help maintain pasture while adding plenty of character to the flock.

Chickens

Our chickens spend their days scratching, foraging, and exploring the farm while providing fresh eggs and helping keep insects under control.

How We Farm

Simple, pasture-based practices focused on healthy animals, healthy soil, and responsible stewardship.

Regenerative Farming

We aim to improve the land as we farm it by using animals, pasture, and natural cycles to support healthier soil and stronger forage.

Frequent Pasture Rotation

Our animals are moved regularly to fresh pasture to support better forage, reduce pressure on the land, and promote healthier living conditions.

Animal Health First

We focus on prevention through clean pasture, proper nutrition, low-stress handling, and living conditions suited to each animal.

Minimal Intervention

We avoid routine antibiotics, unnecessary medications, and unnecessary interventions, relying first on sound husbandry and preventative care.

Organic Feed

When supplemental feed is needed, we use organic feed and prioritize pasture, forage, and natural food sources whenever practical.

Built Around the Land

Our farming decisions are shaped around the seasons, the pasture, and the needs of the animals rather than forcing the farm into a rigid system.

Smoky Mountain Farm Tours & Farm Animals FAQ

Learn more about visiting Smoky Mountain Acres in Cosby, Tennessee, our private farm tours, family activities, and the animals and farm products we offer.

Where is Smoky Mountain Acres located?

Smoky Mountain Acres is located in Cosby, Tennessee, near Cosby Campground and the Great Smoky Mountains National Park. We are a convenient stop for families visiting the Smoky Mountains, Gatlinburg, Cosby, and the surrounding East Tennessee area.

What can we do on a farm tour?

Our farm tours give visitors a chance to experience a working family farm in the Smoky Mountains. Depending on the animals and season, guests may be able to pet animals, feed animals, meet our pigs, sheep, and chickens, explore the farm, and enjoy play equipment for children.

Are your Smoky Mountain farm tours good for children and families?

Yes. Smoky Mountain Acres is designed to be a family-friendly farm experience. Children can see farm animals up close, learn about life on a small Appalachian farm, and enjoy our outdoor play equipment. Farm tours are a good activity for families looking for things to do near Cosby and the Great Smoky Mountains.

Can visitors pet and feed the farm animals?

Yes, when conditions allow. One of the highlights of visiting Smoky Mountain Acres is interacting with our farm animals. Guests may have opportunities to pet and feed pigs, sheep, chickens, and other animals under our supervision.

Do you sell pigs, sheep, chickens, and farm-fresh eggs?

Yes. We periodically offer pigs for homesteads, breeding, pets, or whole-hog meat purchases, along with sheep, chickens, and farm-fresh chicken eggs. Availability changes throughout the year, so contact Smoky Mountain Acres for current livestock and farm product availability.

Do you sell Kune Kune pigs for pets, homesteads, or meat?

Yes. Smoky Mountain Acres raises Kune Kune pigs and may have pigs available for families looking for a farm pet, homestead livestock, breeding animals, or pasture-raised pork. We also periodically offer whole pigs for meat. Contact us for current pigs, piglets, pricing, and availability in Cosby, Tennessee.
